title: Dictionary with Wildcard Lookup

solutions.time: O(L) add, O(26^k * L) wildcard search
O(L) add, O(26^k * L) wildcard search

commonMistakes: Letting a wildcard match more than one character
Returning true when the pattern ends at a nonterminal node
Forgetting to try every child at a wildcard position
Matching a pattern against a word of a different length
followUps: How would you support a wildcard that matches zero or more characters?
How could you memoize searches that repeatedly use the same pattern?
How would you remove a word and clean up unused trie nodes?
